# Step 2: Arrange Cards Horizontally

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Step 2: Arrange Cards Horizontally

In the same way, multiple cards are arranged horizontally using flexbox.

![Step 2: Arrange Cards Horizontally](data:image/png;base64,)

To do this, make cards a flexbox so that flex items of the class card can be:

- Arranged vertically using flex-direction: column;.
- Separated using gap: 24px;.
- Centered using justify-content: center;.

With these changes, your mini-project is now complete.

Try changing the flex properties here to see how they affect the layout. You can also try adding more cards or card items or changing the container's dimensions.
